title: [smime-tree] RSA-PSS chain validation support
description: pkix-path does not yet support RSA-PSS (RFC 4055) SignatureVerifiers. Certificate chains where a CA signs with RSA-PSS will fail chain validation. Rare in practice for S/MIME CAs but may appear in government/enterprise PKIs. Blocked on upstream pkix-path implementation (PKIX-gphz). File an issue if you need this.
